name: showandtell
description: Turn Codex computer-use screenshots and actions into local videos with smooth cursor motion.

interface.longDescription: Turn supported Codex computer-use actions into local MP4 walkthroughs with smooth cursor motion. Saves screenshots directly on your Mac and renders with FFmpeg. Requires desktop computer use, Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, and trusted command hooks. Captures snapshots rather than continuous screen footage.
defaultPrompt: Use Showandtell to make a video of this walkthrough.
Use Showandtell to export my saved capture as an MP4.
